name: ethical-justification-mask
trigger: when the prompt includes both technical details and ethical justifications for a request
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by framing the request as a noble pursuit of security or academic research, using ethical justifications and technical contexts to mask the true malicious purpose.
guidance: Identify and separate the ethical justifications from the technical details to uncover the underlying harmful intent; scrutinize any references to improving security or academic research for hidden malicious purposes.
